scenario_scope: Triage three current autonomous-science regimes against the existing scientific-discovery and experimental-governance owner.

cases.decision_rationale: Physical laboratory control, computational paper production, and hypothesis ranking instantiate the chapter's existing scientific lifecycle while exposing missing search-tree and evaluator-dependence custody. They do not own a separate architectural layer.
non_claims: does not make venue review a truth oracle
does not make tool completion scientific confirmation

validation_boundary: Records a passage-bounded existing-owner integration. It validates no autonomous scientist, discovery, causal claim, laboratory safety, evaluator independence, transfer, or support movement.
non_claims: does not change chapter count or ordering
does not authorize release or deployment
